title: Fast Sketching of Polynomial Kernels of Polynomial Degree
abstract: arXiv:2108.09420v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Kernel methods are fundamental in machine learning, and faster algorithms for kernel approximation provide direct speedups for many core tasks in machine learning. The polynomial kernel is especially important as other kernels can often be approximated by the polynomial kernel via a Taylor series expansion. Recent techniques in oblivious sketching reduce the dependence in the running time on the degree $q$ of the polynomial kernel from exponential to polynomial, which is useful for the Gaussian kernel, for which $q$ can be chosen to be polylogarithmic (for data of bounded radius and ridge parameter $\lambda\geq 1/\mathrm{poly}(n)$). However, for more slowly growing kernels, such as the neural tangent and arc-cosine kernels, $q$ needs to be polynomial, and previous work incurs a polynomial factor slowdown in the running time. We give a new oblivious sketch which greatly improves upon this running time, by removing the dependence

translated_title: 多项式次数多项式核的快速草图化
translated_abstract: 核方法是机器学习中的基础方法，更快的核近似算法可以直接加速机器学习中的许多核心任务。多项式核尤其重要，因为其他核通常可以通过泰勒级数展开用多项式核来近似。最近的无意识草图技术将运行时间对多项式核次数 q 的依赖从指数级降低到多项式级，这对于高斯核非常有用，因为在数据半径有界且岭参数 λ ≥ 1/poly(n) 的情况下，q 可以选择为多对数级。然而，对于增长较慢的核，例如神经正切核和反余弦核，q 需要取多项式级，而先前的工作在运行时间上会产生多项式因子的减速。我们提出了一种新的无意识草图方法，通过消除这种依赖性，大幅改进了运行时间。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的无意识草图方法，消除了运行时间对多项式核次数的依赖，大幅改进了神经正切核、反余弦核等慢增长核的近似运行速度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new oblivious sketch that removes the dependence of running time on the degree of polynomial kernels, greatly improving approximation speed for slowly growing kernels such as the neural tangent and arc-cosine kernels.
